outcome_detail: Wrongful-death suit stayed at the estate's request pending the federal criminal prosecution of Matthew Farwell; as of mid-2026 the civil case remains pending, with Farwell's federal trial scheduled for October 5, 2026.
criminal_detail: Matthew Farwell was arrested in August 2024 and federally indicted on one count of killing a witness or victim; a superseding indictment added a count for causing the death of Birchmore's unborn child. He pleaded not guilty, was denied bail in May 2026, and his jury trial is set for October 5, 2026 (prosecutors are not seeking the death penalty). William Farwell and Robert Devine have not been criminally charged; Devine was decertified by the Massachusetts POST Commission in December 2025 and the Farwell brothers agreed to give up their law-enforcement certification.
incident_date_approx: Alleged grooming beginning around 2010-2012 in the Stoughton Police Explorers program, with alleged sexual abuse starting when Birchmore was 15; she was found dead in her Canton, MA apartment on February 1, 2021, at age 23 while pregnant.
description: The estate of Sandra Birchmore, administered by her aunt, filed a wrongful-death lawsuit in December 2022 against former Stoughton police officers Matthew Farwell, William Farwell and Robert Devine, as well as the Town of Stoughton and its police department. The suit alleges the three officers groomed and sexually assaulted Birchmore beginning when she was a minor enrolled in the department's youth Explorers program, and that Matthew Farwell began having sex with her when she was 15, and it accuses the town of negligent hiring and supervision. Birchmore was found dead in her apartment in February 2021 while pregnant; her death was initially ruled a suicide. Federal prosecutors later charged Matthew Farwell with killing her by strangulation and staging the scene to look like a suicide, allegedly to prevent her from disclosing his sexual exploitation of her; he has pleaded not guilty. In 2026 the state medical examiner amended her manner of death from 'suicide' to 'undetermined.' The civil case is stayed pending the criminal trial.
notes: Seed year hint of 2021 corresponds to the year of Birchmore's death; the wrongful-death suit itself was filed in late December 2022. Massachusetts medical examiner changed her manner of death from suicide to undetermined in April 2026. Defendants William Farwell and Robert Devine deny the accusations in the civil litigation.
